contract: Replacing a comptime data value preserves distinct and shared allocations within that value, including observable reference equality and property order.

cases.name: shared object
cases.body: const same = { n: 1 }; return { a: same, b: same };

cases.name: shared array
cases.body: const same = [1]; return { a: same, b: same };

cases.name: nested shared object
cases.body: const same = { n: 1 }; return { a: { child: same }, b: { child: same } };

cases.name: shared values retain property order
cases.body: const same = { z: 1, a: 2 }; return { z: same, a: same };

cases.name: prototype spelling remains an own data property
cases.body: const same = JSON.parse('{"__proto__":7}'); return { a: same, b: same };

cases.name: numeric property order
cases.body: const same = {}; return { '10': same, '2': same, x: same };

cases.name: shared descendant of a shared parent
cases.body: const leaf = [1]; const branch = { left: leaf, right: leaf }; return { a: branch, b: branch, c: leaf };
cases.observe: String(value.a === value.b && value.a.left === value.c && value.b.right === value.c)

cases.name: distinct parents with shared descendants
cases.body: const leaf = [1]; return { a: { child: leaf }, b: { child: leaf } };

cases.name: shallow array copy keeps element identity
cases.body: const same = { n: 1 }; const rows = [same]; return { a: rows, b: rows.slice() };
